To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the oceans past is not a single story; 2) the oceans past cannot be told without a focus on the past; 3) the oceans past needs to be understood in a global perspective; 4) the oceans past has to be told with the use of a wide range of historical data; and 5) the oceans past should be told in a multidisciplinary manner.

the future of the oceans past lies in the integration of the humanities, social and natural sciences, and in the global collaboration between marine environmental historians, historical ecologists and marine scientists.
